notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki.

Prepared update for 10:59. 

1. Added 8 new jumpscares
2. Reworked part of the riddle in the children's room.
3. Improved the operation of the riddle with fives in the children's room.
4. Added clues for some of the riddles.
5. Improved the operation of the lights.
6. Fixed localization textures for the diary.
7. Improved some sounds.
8. Fixed other minor bugs.
